question.text: Sanctions permissible under the PIT Code of Conduct include ALL EXCEPT:

answer.text: Mandatory public disclosure of personal trading details

explanation.text: The Logic: Permissible sanctions and disciplinary actions under the PIT Code of Conduct include wage freeze, suspension, recovery, and clawback. Mandatory public disclosure of an employee's personal trading details is not listed as a permissible sanction under the Code. The Trap: Wage freeze, suspension, and clawback are explicitly listed sanctions in the source and therefore cannot be the exception. Only the public-disclosure option is outside the permissible list. Note: Replaced the unserious "Public flogging" distractor with a professional but incorrect sanction so the question matches NISM exam style.
